resolutions.note: EO 13031 (1996-12-13) supersedes EO 12844, but EO 12974 Sec. 3(b) already revoked the fleet task force portion of EO 12844 and that one-time command was spent on 1995-09-30; the revoked portion is not a continued committee, so no EO 12974 clause ends or changes because of it.

Held EO:13203 (after 1997-09-30) revokes EO 12871, the establishing order of a committee that EO 12974 Sec. 1 continued only until 1997-09-30; EO 13062 supersedes EO 12974 effective that date, so the revocation is a later event after the first end and changes no end date.
